{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u006/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3398452e.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill one-cell horizontal gaps between matching non-background markers.

    The background is the most frequent color; inserted cells use the
    smallest color absent from the input.
    """
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    used = set(counts)
    fill = next(c for c in range(10) if c not in used)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] == grid[r][c + 2] and grid[r][c + 1] == background:
                out[r][c + 1] = fill
    return out
"
